"Defeat Regis, and you may find a way to escape from this space as well."

We've got no choice but to go... into that Gate...!!
"Regis" is on the other side of this Gate... Even I can't tell if we'll make it back alive.
...Guess you already know that much. Let's go. You ready?
Tch! ...You could've at least come prepared. Hurry up and get it done.
"You've entered the Ride Dungeon...!! This is it... We're counting on you, understood!? Good luck!!"
"I expect this will be a hard fight, but I believe in all of you!!"
Now that it's come to this, we've got no choice but to go, right!?

notes.note: Script 0733: leader R0 (CHARA_NAME of leader). If R0==3 (Den-O Sword Form/Momotaros) play #226; if R0 in {4 W/Shotaro, 5 OOO, 9 Wing Zero, 10 00} play #225; else #218. Extracted 'Nu Gundam' labels on #218/#225/#226 are wrong. #219-224 and #227-232 are never played; identical Japanese gets identical English. Contemptuous suffix rendered 'Regis, damn you...' as for Belial in earlier slices.

Zoffy (CHARA_NAME 128) over comms, double quotes as in story_169. Answers the leader's 'Regis...'. Regis is g=n in the glossary: 'its ambitions'; #235 repeats 'Regis' instead of a pronoun for the source's 'that one'.

Pairs #243+R9/#244+R9, third Pt_Chara_Check chain (R9 step 2): Zero, OOO, Nu Gundam, W (Shotaro), Zeta Gundam, Mebius, Den-O Sword Form, Wing Zero, 00, Black RX, Rider 1, Ultraman, Seven, God Gundam, Taro. '?party' on #243 = Zero. 'They' = the revived bosses (Gundam Head etc. shown just before); subject restored.
Momotaros (Den-O Sword Form): contemptuous verb forms, rough English.
#261/#263 = Black RX / Rider 1 ('to iu no ka', disbelief).
Leader reply to Ankh: R0==14 (Mebius) plays #282 'Yes', R0==3 (Momotaros) plays #284, everyone else #276. Extracted 'Taro' labels on #276/#282/#284 are wrong. #277-281, #283, #285-291 never played.
Script 0734: TextIdOffset 0; Ankh (36) says #1, then #2 is the Yes/No prompt text (still Ankh). Answering No plays #6 (Ankh) and ends the event.
Zoffy (128) then Hikari (35), comm lines in double quotes. 'tanonda zo!?' rendered 'We're counting on you, understood!?' (Zoffy asking the party).
Not played by the script (Zoffy #13, Hikari #14, then leader #16+R1). Speaker unknown; translated plainly.

Leader block #16+R1, check order: W (Shotaro), Zero, God Gundam, Mebius, Den-O Sword Form, OOO, Zeta Gundam, Nu Gundam, Black RX, Rider 1 (#26-30 next slice: Taro, Ultraman, Seven, 00, Wing Zero). Subject 'we' restored: the leader answers for the party heading in. Plain variant matches story_171's 'Yeah, we're going in!' for the same Japanese.
